title: AI Fluency for Builders
description: Architecting and shipping end-to-end intelligent applications: combining modern frontend frameworks, LLM orchestrators, database integrations, and robust user interface feedback loops.

title: AI Fluency for Nonprofits
description: Applying cost-conscious generative AI tools to amplify mission-driven impact, automate grant drafting, streamline community outreach, and optimize nonprofit administrative resources.

title: Claude on Google Cloud
description: Deploying, securing, and scaling Claude models natively inside Google Cloud Vertex AI: configuring enterprise VPC networks, IAM service accounts, and integrating with Google Cloud data services.

title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
description: Provisioning and consuming Claude models on Amazon Bedrock: configuring AWS IAM policies, invoking Bedrock Runtime APIs, setting up Bedrock Guardrails, and designing serverless event-driven architectures.

title: Introduction to Agent Skills
description: Authoring, packaging, and evaluating autonomous agent skills that extend model behavior with structured capabilities, contextual memory, and goal-oriented tool execution.

title: Introduction to Subagents
description: Designing multi-agent architectures where an orchestrator agent delegates specialized sub-tasks to isolated subagents, coordinating parallel workflows and structured context synthesis.

title: Teaching AI Fluency
description: Train-the-trainer methodology for delivering impactful AI fluency workshops, mentoring engineering teams, and establishing technical literacy programs across organizations.

title: Digital Awareness
description: Cisco, in collaboration with OpenEDG, verifies the learner has demonstrated an entry-level understanding of digital tools and technologies and their applications in everyday life. The learner possesses the basic skills to identify and utilize the functions of common digital devices, navigate digital content responsibly, and manage their online presence effectively. Additionally, the learner understands the evolution of digital technologies and the importance of ethical and responsible usage.

title: IT Customer Support Basics
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the IT Customer Support Basics course. This student-level credential demonstrates foundational knowledge in help desk operations, customer service, and remote troubleshooting. The holder is proficient in using industry-standard tools to assist users in resolving technical issues and can effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical users.

title: Discovering Entrepreneurship
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Discovering Entrepreneurship course and achieved the student level credential. Earners have knowledge of the key principles of entrepreneurship including the concepts, strategies, and tools needed to succeed as a small business owner, franchisee, founder, or other entrepreneurial professional.

title: Python Essentials 2
description: Cisco, in collaboration with OpenEDG Python Institute, verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Python Essentials 2 course and achieved the student level credentials. Earners have knowledge and skills in intermediate aspects of Python programming, including modules, packages, exceptions, file processing, as well as general coding techniques and object-oriented programming (OOP), and prepares the learner for the PCAP – Certified Associate in Python Programming certification.

title: AI Fluency for pK–12 Educators
description: Comprehensive certification under Anthropic's pK-12 Learning Path covering foundational AI literacy, student privacy guardrails, and age-appropriate generative AI teaching methodologies.

title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
description: In-depth theoretical and practical grounding in large language model fundamentals: transformer self-attention, token dynamics, constitutional alignment, and systematic prompt engineering.

title: Building with the Claude API
description: Full-stack software engineering using the official Anthropic SDK: implementing structured JSON outputs, function calling, multimodal vision processing, token budget optimizations, and resilient retry logic.

title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
description: Engineering production-grade custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: implementing server-sent events (SSE) and stdio transports, resource templates, dynamic sampling, and strict sandboxing.

title: Build Your Resume with AI
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Build Your Resume with AI course. The learner has practiced using AI tools to extract, tailor, and format resume content while protecting sensitive information. They have applied privacy‑first workflows, validated AI outputs through systematic review, and produced professional, ATS‑friendly resumes customized to specific job postings.

title: Core Generative AI Skills
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Core Generative AI Skills course, part of the Cisco AI Business Practitioner (AIBIZ) learning collection. The learner demonstrates foundational knowledge of generative AI concepts, tools, use cases, and responsible AI practices for professional, business, academic, and team settings.

title: AI Fluency for Educators
description: Pedagogical frameworks for integrating generative AI into modern classrooms, creating adaptive lesson plans, and guiding students in responsible, critical AI utilization.

title: Claude Platform 101
description: Foundational mastery of the Anthropic Developer Platform, API architecture, model selection (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Haiku, Opus), developer console evaluation tools, and structured prompt engineering.

title: Claude Code in Action
description: Advanced practical execution with Claude Code across production software repositories, automated test generation, cross-system refactoring, and real-time git integration.

title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
description: Architecting collaborative human-in-the-loop workflows with Claude, multi-user project spaces, structured memory management, and enterprise artifact sharing.

title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
description: Comprehensive understanding of the open Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard, enabling secure, two-way communication between Claude and external data sources, local development tooling, and cloud APIs.

title: AI Fluency for Creative Work
description: Integrating frontier LLMs into creative ideation, UI/UX concept design, copywriting systems, brand voice alignment, and generative multimedia development.

title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
description: Deploying cost-effective generative AI workflows to streamline operations, automate customer support, generate analytics reports, and optimize growth strategies for small businesses.

title: Deploying Claude Enterprise with Confidence
description: The five architectural and governance decisions shaping enterprise AI rollouts: data privacy boundaries, identity federation (SSO/SCIM), audit logging, compliance, and departmental scaling.

title: JavaScript Essentials 1
description: Cisco, in collaboration with OpenEDG JS Institute, verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the JavaScript Essentials 1 course and achieved the student level credentials. Earners know the syntax of the core JavaScript; can work with variables, operators, flow control, and functions; know the basics of data types system; think algorithmically and can analyze problems using a programmatic conceptual apparatus; and can design, develop, and improve simple JavaScript programs.

title: Claude Code 101
description: Certified proficiency in Claude Code, Anthropic's research-grade agentic command-line interface for terminal-native software development, multi-file code editing, and architectural codebase understanding.

title: Operating Systems Basics
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Operating Systems Basics course and achieved this student level credential. Earner has fundamental knowledge of operating systems by covering the basic concepts and skills needed to explain the purpose and characteristics of operating systems, implement basic operating system security, and explain how to configure mobile device network connectivity and email.

title: Ethical Hacker
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Ethical Hacker course. The holder of this student level credential has a broad understanding of the legal and compliance requirements and is proficient in the art of scoping, executing, reporting vulnerability assessments, and recommending mitigation strategies. The holder has completed up to 34 hands-on activities using Kali Linux, WebSploit, and other tools.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Cybersecurity course. The holder of this student-level credential has introductory knowledge of cybersecurity, including the global implications of cyber threats on industries, and why cybersecurity is a growing profession. They understand vulnerabilities and threat detection and defense. They also have insight into opportunities available with pursuing cybersecurity certifications.

title: Introduction to IoT
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Internet of Things course. The holder of this student-level credential has introductory knowledge of IoT and has an understanding how it enables the Digital Transformation along with emerging technologies such as data analytics, AI/ML and the increased attention on cybersecurity. They understand the importance of Intent Based Networking to be able to connect and secure tens of billions of new devices with ease.

title: Introduction to Modern AI
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Modern AI course. The learner will have practiced using AI enabled features on free apps, such as photo apps, translation services, and chatbots. They will have had in depth practice in prompting a chatbot, and understand fundamentals of how the models work, which informs how they prompt chatbots.

title: Networking Basics
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Networking Basics course and achieved this student level credential. Earner has knowledge of the types of networks, how they work, how devices send and receive data, the types of network cabling, how IP addresses find information on the Internet, how transport and applications operate, and has practiced building a home wireless network. Participated in up to 13 Cisco Packet Tracer activities.

title: Prompt Like an Engineer
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Prompt Like an Engineer course. The learner has practiced applying an engineering mindset to design, iterate, verify, and reuse prompts as a repeatable process. They understand how chatbots and large language models work, how to choose between cloud and local AI tools while protecting sensitive data, and how to systematically evaluate AI outputs, keeping a human in the lead and remaining accountable for the quality of their work.

title: Python Essentials 1
description: Cisco, in collaboration with OpenEDG Python Institute, verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Python Essentials 1 course and achieved the student level credentials. Earners have knowledge of the concepts of computer programming, the syntax and semantics of the Python language as well as demonstrate the ability to accomplish coding tasks related to the essentials of programming in the Python language and resolve implementation challenges using the Python Standard Library.

title: Operating Systems Support
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge has successfully completed the Operating Systems Support course, demonstrating proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving issues across Windows, macOS, and mobile operating systems. The holder of this credential has foundational knowledge in virtualization and cloud computing concepts, preparing them for entry-level roles in IT support. Through lectures and hands-on exercises, the holder has developed technical and customer service skills.

title: Computer Hardware Basics
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Computer Hardware Basics course and achieved this student level credential. Earner has fundamentals knowledge of computers and mobile devices, how they work, as well as the basic concepts and skills needed to install components to build, repair, upgrade personal computers and and basic troubleshooting tools and techniques.

title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
description: Rigorous technical assessment of LLM boundaries, hallucination mechanisms, mathematical and reasoning edge cases, and verification strategies for mission-critical software systems.

title: AI Fluency for Students
description: Ethical frameworks, accelerated research methodologies, and career-building technical foundations for students navigating modern AI-assisted engineering and scholarship.

title: Claude 101
description: Comprehensive certification in core Claude principles, constitutional AI design, context manipulation, and structured conversation engineering across diverse operational scenarios.
